adr: ADR-0003 DEC-18; PM second-launch ruling; initech-slvd first half
abi: INT13 AH60 AL=zero-based DOS letter; EBX=20-byte map: uint32 disk,partition,base,sectors,flags; CF/AH status per DEC-17. A partition 0 means superfloppy else partition 1. B always invalid.
running_identity: mounted current volume (disk, partition base); running flag compares both, never disk alone
selection: A=81h raw FAT or first primary FAT; C=80h primary 1; D=80h primary 2. No active-flag reordering. Missing/extended/non-FAT/out-of-bounds entries invalid.
removable: A is the logical diskette role on ATA hardware; B absent; C/D fixed. This role is PM policy, not an FDC claim.
